code.python:
x = [1, 2, 3]
y = [3, 5, 9]
w = 2
errors = [w * xi - yi for xi, yi in zip(x, y)]
print(errors)                      # [-1, -1, -3]
print([e ** 2 for e in errors])    # [1, 1, 9]
